affectedPublicSurfaces: juli-api process startup (new hard dependency on SUPABASE_JWT_SECRET)

candidateVerificationJourney.restrictedRoute: loopback candidate on the existing VPS with SUPABASE_JWT_SECRET present; exercise a valid token, an empty-key-signed token, and a boot with the variable removed

journeys.name: valid-session-still-works
journeys.entryUrl: loopback candidate: GET /v1/shops with a correctly signed token
assertions: response body shape unchanged from stable

journeys.name: empty-key-forgery-rejected
journeys.entryUrl: loopback candidate: GET /v1/shops with a token signed using an empty-string key

journeys.name: boot-fails-without-secret
journeys.entryUrl: loopback candidate started with SUPABASE_JWT_SECRET unset

htmlRoutes: not-applicable: backend/config change with no HTML route or static asset

migrationCompatibility.notes: No schema change. This alters process startup requirements only: the candidate will refuse to boot if the secret is absent from the fetched env, which is the intended behaviour and must be verified before cutover, not after.

rollbackAssertion.postCutoverFailureBehavior: redeploy prior stable revision; note that a rollback does NOT restore the fail-open behaviour as a mitigation — if the secret is genuinely missing, fix the secret, not the code

doNotInfer: Do not assume SUPABASE_JWT_SECRET is present in any environment — verify it is in the fetched env file before cutover, because this change converts absence into an outage
Do not weaken the assertion to a warning to keep a broken environment booting
Do not change any token's audience or algorithm while touching this path
